reason: Same-policy ExtraTrees outperformed full-finetuned Kronos-base on development. Freeze it before opening the first heldout interval.
no_automatic_leverage_increase: Require independently positive, monotonic confidence buckets before exposure above 1x. Ensemble disagreement is not calibrated probability.
reuse_rule: After inspection a holdout becomes research. Do not tune and retest the same interval as if independent.
warning: Historical holdout, not a live forward test. August/September2026 already inspected in earlier work and excluded from reserve. Few swing trades imply weak statistical evidence.
